descripcion: On-device AI agent for Android, tuned for free OpenRouter/Kilo models with automatic model/key fallback and rate-limit recovery. Tools: web search/fetch over HTTP, bash/Python in Termux (optional headless Chromium + Selenium), Shizuku/rish shell, Accessibility, ebook translation, Documents/Verdroid, Git, crypto market data. No backend.
